name: Children Are A Blessing
overview: Scripture reveals that children are a divine blessing and a heritage from the LORD, as seen in Psalms 127:3 where they are described as the fruit of the womb and a reward from God. From the creation mandate in Genesis 1:28, God commanded humanity to be fruitful and multiply, underscoring the significance of children in His design. The joy and provision of children are further highlighted in Psalms 113:9, where God makes the barren woman a joyful mother. These truths emphasize that honoring God and walking in His ways brings the blessing of children, as affirmed in Psalms 128:1.
